game: Fallout: New Vegas (FNV Co-Op package on nv-rs)

requires.hint: use the FNV Co-Op package (fnv-coop-...-windows-x64.zip from github.com/cranebeaker/fnv-coop/releases), extracted whole, not the plain nv-rs preview.
run Play.exe in the package folder once alone, so it finds Fallout: New Vegas and reads the graphics card and the sound device. Close the game, then start here.

tips: Player 1 hosts the story, everyone else joins on this PC by themselves: no join code is needed.
Everybody presses New Game. Each player makes their own character at Doc Mitchell's.
Each player's controller is read by the game as its own pad (NV_PAD). A player on keyboard and mouse needs no controller.
Each seat keeps its own saves and settings in its own copy of the package. Saves of the package folder itself are not used.
